findings: Actual graphical clients execute a normal Sapphire Crystal purchase, learn Annie E, cast it once and receive authoritative mana regeneration from isolated local servers.

Five screenshots per backend visually inspected: original mana, increased maximum after purchase, full precast mana, reduced current mana after cast and increased current mana after regeneration. Native MPStat glyphs and source-atlas bar update during ordinary UDP state delivery.
Capture-request traces verify HUD text values match current authoritative snapshots; evidence includes local player inventory, rank, cooldown/effect and capacities plus actual command packets.
limits: Only mana changes for Annie E and one item purchase qualified graphically, including existing fountain sustain; original fountain-rule fidelity remains open. Complete Annie kit/effects, graphical health damage/death/respawn, other champions and complete gameplay remain open.

Screenshot capture is asynchronous. Capture-request snapshot may differ from rendered image by a few ticks. Reviewed mana text matches each source record exactly; frame-by-frame packet/renderer synchronization remains open.
Probe is opt-in and restricted to Annie and loopback server; ordinary play does not issue these scripted commands. Native original client network protocol identity is not claimed.

Native formatter/localization/actor accessors, resource variants, lost-health/shields/highlights, regeneration numbers, XP, abilities/items/minimap and interactions remain open. All24domains and complete champion kits remain unclosed.
